label: OncoFic-001 | Phase II, oncology
documentText:
CLINICAL TRIAL PROTOCOL: OncoFic-001
A Phase II, open-label, single-arm study of ONC-77 in adults with advanced solid tumours
Sponsor: Oncovia SA. Protocol code OF-001. Version 2.1.

1. GENERAL INFORMATION
Protocol title, code, version and date are provided. Sponsor, coordinating investigator, and participating sites are listed with contact details. Medical monitor named.

2. BACKGROUND
ONC-77 is an oral kinase inhibitor. Non-clinical pharmacology, toxicology summary and the rationale for the target population are summarised, with references to the Investigator's Brochure v3.

3. OBJECTIVES
Primary objective: objective response rate (ORR) per RECIST 1.1 at 6 months. Secondary objectives: progression-free survival, safety and tolerability. Objectives are specific and measurable.

4. TRIAL DESIGN
Open-label, single-arm, multicentre. Planned enrolment 45 subjects. Primary endpoint, schedule of assessments, and stopping rules for the study are described. A schematic of visits is included.

5. SELECTION AND WITHDRAWAL OF SUBJECTS
Inclusion and exclusion criteria are enumerated. Withdrawal criteria and procedures, and replacement policy, are defined.

6. TREATMENT OF SUBJECTS
Dose, route, schedule of ONC-77, dose-modification rules, and permitted/prohibited concomitant medications are specified. Treatment compliance monitoring described.

7. ASSESSMENT OF EFFICACY
Efficacy parameters (RECIST 1.1) and the timing/method of tumour assessment are defined.

8. ASSESSMENT OF SAFETY
Adverse event definitions, grading (CTCAE v5), SAE reporting timelines and causality assessment are specified, with the safety reporting flow to the sponsor.

9. STATISTICS
Sample size is justified for the primary ORR endpoint (Simon two-stage). Analysis populations defined. No pre-specified interim-analysis plan or rules for early stopping for efficacy/futility are documented.

10. DIRECT ACCESS TO SOURCE DATA/DOCUMENTS
A statement confirms investigators/institutions permit monitoring, audit, IRB/IEC review and regulatory inspection with direct source access.

11. QUALITY CONTROL AND QUALITY ASSURANCE
Monitoring plan and data-quality procedures are described.

12. ETHICS
Reference to Declaration of Helsinki, IRB/IEC approval and informed-consent process are described.

13. DATA HANDLING AND RECORD KEEPING
eCRF, data management and retention periods are specified.

14. FINANCING AND INSURANCE
A statement references a separate financing and insurance agreement.

15. SUPPLEMENTS
Appendices (schedule of assessments, sample consent form) are attached.
